Sparkling Tones, part five: live view and banks.
The live view gives you big buttons to hit while you play. The one that's playing lights up.
Banks hold eight sounds of your choice, in any order, taken from your whole library.
Hold a button for two seconds, and you're straight into its knobs.
To make a new bank, tap "plus bank" and give it a name.
Then fill the spots: one tap on the spot, one tap on the preset.
Your banks never write to the amp: its eight presets stay exactly as they are.
Sparkling Tones: free, and it works offline. Next: the tuner.
